journey.title: Expose a scenario
journey.purpose: Let an operator expose a known manifest route only after target, duration, hostname, tier, authentication, and publicness are reviewed.

steps.intent: Inspect readiness findings and choose the primary exposure action.
Choose a known manifest-backed route and inspect its target and hostname.
Configure bounded lease duration and review tier, authentication, and /public/* behavior.
Confirm provisioning and follow classified progress or remediation.
Verify the resulting URL, expiry, policy, and local-to-external checks.

claims.statement: The journey does not submit until target, duration, hostname, and access scope have been reviewed.
